description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels—Simple, Moderate, and Challenging—as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis displays the task complexity categories, while the vertical axis measures execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in increments of 10. For each category, two bars represent the performance of NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue). In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21, while TA-SQL reaches 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64, and TA-SQL achieves 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL maintains a score of 32.32, while TA-SQL scores 36.11. The Total category shows NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest performance gap observed in the Moderate category. The chart indicates that TA-SQL demonstrates higher accuracy than NatSQL in all evaluated scenarios, with a notable improvement in the Total category.
